visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and a young girl with braided pigtails stand in a modern, brightly lit white kitchen. The girl excitedly holds a plastic container of green sesame leaves and a bag of shirataki noodles. (2) The scene shifts to the stove where the girl, assisted by the man, pours the shirataki noodles into a white pot of boiling water. They later move to the sink to strain the noodles using a metal mesh strainer. (3) In a black frying pan, the man adds garlic and shrimp, which turn pink as they cook. The girl uses a black spatula to stir canned tomato sauce into the pan under the man's guidance. (4) The cooked noodles are added to the pan, and the man grinds black pepper over the mixture while the girl watches intently. (5) The man plates the finished tomato shirataki pasta on a white plate, grates fresh cheese over it, and garnishes it with the green leaves. (6) The man and girl sit at a wooden dining table eating the meal; a small 'mini portion' is set aside for the girl. (7) The setting changes to a dimly lit indoor golf simulator with green turf. The man, now in a dark t-shirt and shorts, practices his golf swing repeatedly, showing signs of physical fatigue and shoulder pain. (8) Back in the kitchen at night, the man sits alone at the table, eating a bowl of pig blood soup and peeling a hard-boiled egg for a post-workout snack. (9) A simple 2D animation of a boy lying down and a girl standing appears on a solid yellow background to conclude the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces dinner, followed by a bright, high-pitched female child voice repeating the phrase. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM fades in. (2) Sound of plastic bag rustling as shirataki noodles are handled. (3) Bubbling water sounds and liquid splashing as noodles are boiled and strained. Male voice gives narrative instructions. (4) A sharp click as a gas stove ignites, followed by the steady hiss of sizzling shrimp. (5) Metallic scraping and plastic tapping sounds as sauce and noodles are stirred in a pan. (6) A consistent 'Whoosh' SFX accompanies visual cuts. (7) Percussive grinding sound of a manual pepper mill. (8) Sound of a grater against cheese. (9) Transition to golf: Repeated high-velocity impact thuds as the golf club hits the ball. The man's voice exhibits strain and audible exhales of exertion and pain. (10) Slurping sounds as the man eats soup, accompanied by the quiet rustle of an egg shell being peeled. BGM continues at a low volume.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Home cooking process -> Communal dining -> Individual physical training -> Post-exercise nutritional recovery
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video showcases a healthy lifestyle routine combining calorie-controlled family cooking (shirataki pasta) with dedicated late-night physical exercise (golf simulator) and specific post-workout nutrition (pig blood soup), aimed at weight management and fitness discipline.
